title: Is Out(F_3) linear?
premise_risks: Open status confirmed from 2006 survey and 2012 Kielak paper; no 2024-26 resolution found but no recent survey checked verbatim
Whether Out(F_3) contains no Formanek–Procesi subgroup is taken from the survey's framing
plain: The outer automorphism group of the free group on three letters, Out(F_3), is a basic finitely presented group in geometric group theory. Does it have a faithful representation by complex matrices of some size? For two letters it does (it is GL_2(Z)). For four or more letters it does not, because it then contains Aut(F_3), which Formanek and Procesi showed is not linear. Three letters is the single open case.
math: Let $F_3$ be the free group of rank $3$ and $\mathrm{Out}(F_3)=\mathrm{Aut}(F_3)/\mathrm{Inn}(F_3)$. Determine whether there exist $m\in\mathbb N$ and an injective group homomorphism $\mathrm{Out}(F_3)\hookrightarrow \mathrm{GL}_m(\mathbb C)$.
